findings.problem: The red '8 min off' tag sits on the green dashed truth line (and next to the new dots at 3 km): the line runs through the sticker, so the gap label is hard to read and looks cluttered.
findings.fix: Anchor the tag by its right edge just left of the red gap, above the green line at the top of the gap (y = 24 min), where the plot is empty.

findings.problem: After the window takes over (7.6-8.2) the memory frame, chip and label fade out and the red warnings leave, so the bottom half of the stage is empty except one purple tag; the picture never says that the 4-week window now fits in memory, which is the point of the fix.
findings.fix: Keep the memory frame and label on screen (week 33 slides back inside it) and, where 'does not fit in memory' was, pop a green solid 'fits in memory' tag with a green tick.

findings.problem: On a loss axis 0..280 the one-at-a-time ball sits near loss 2 from about 3 s on, so its uphill steps (tenths of a unit) are invisible; only one 'uphill' tag and brief red flashes back up the caption 'some steps go uphill'.
findings.fix: Add a red counter in the one-at-a-time panel ('1 uphill' ... '10 uphill', from RACE.ups) that pops at the first uphill update and bumps at each one, so the noise is countable on screen.

findings.problem: Row 1 pictogram: the ball stops at w = 4.75 and the green 'settled' ring is drawn round the ball beside the green best dot, so the finished picture reads as 'stopped short of the bottom'.
findings.fix: Hop through all five D9.DESC weights (10, 7, 5.5, 4.75, 4.375) and put the green ring round the best dot, which now encloses the ball.

findings.problem: The caption says 'Prior shift', but the lesson (and the boss quiz) name it 'prior probability shift'; a learner would not match the exam term.
findings.fix: Caption: 'Prior probability shift: same symptoms; before, 12 in 20 had flu.' (the 30 px tag keeps the short 'prior shift', it cannot fit the full name in a 296 px column).

findings.problem: The three cards are 440 px tall but their content ends at the label (y 450), leaving about 70 px of empty card at the bottom of each column.
findings.fix: Shorten the cards to 400 px and move the bottom 'inputs change' tags up to y 550.

findings.problem: The last caption lists the losses 133, 33 and 1.9 in bottom-to-top row order while the rows read top to bottom (1.9, 33.02, 133.38).
findings.fix: Let the narration name each row with its loss; the loss tags on each row already pair them.

findings.problem: As record 1 rides on after the update it slides behind the model card, so for a moment its text is cut off ('3 km · 15 mi').
findings.fix: Acceptable as 'passing through the model'; could fade the record as it enters the card.

findings.problem: At the end both a green 'cost 0' tag in the left column and a green 'best: w = 4, cost 0' tag on the plot say the same thing.
findings.fix: Leave it: the left tag is the live readout that ends at 0.

findings.problem: Brand and technical checks pass: no white, gradients, blur, filters, timers or randomness in videos/d9; same PNG md5 for s4@5, s8@9, s10@9, s12@8.9 rendered in two orders; eslint and prettier clean; info total 126 s with no page errors; first frames of each scene look normal. Total 126 s is slightly over the 95-120 s band of the review brief but inside the series' 130 s cap.
findings.evidence: md5 of rev-d9/detA vs detB; node tools/video-still.js ds-9 info (lens: brand)
